page.overview:
What is Adventure Marionette?

, also referred to as Adventure Puppet, is an unlockable character in FNaF World.

The Marionette has a very similar appearance to his counterpart from the core series, being smaller, having slightly thicker limbs, and a rounder mask. He appears to have stumps at the end of his legs. He also has fewer stripes than the Marionette from the core series, having a total of twelve instead of twenty-eight.

Marionette's only attack that deals damage is Prize Ball 2, which deals a randomly selected attack. The "esc" key is good against groups of difficult enemies. If the party is about to be destroyed, players can use Mystery Box to randomly select party members to assist during battle.
